No human or model opinion is used to assert ground truth; the checked-in adjudication records name the deterministic verifier as reviewer. The dataset is a controlled experiment with machine-verifiable outcomes, per the protocol allowance for ground truth independently verified from structured outputs and reproducible tests.
limitations: Tasks were constructed by an AI agent (Vibe, operating as repository maintainer under delegated authority) rather than collected from production traffic; the ground truth itself is mechanical and does not depend on that authorship.

Task difficulty is concentrated on deterministic verification categories (arithmetic, counting, membership, date math, string transforms, extremum, table lookup, evidence support); it does not sample open-ended generation quality.

This dataset satisfies the CAP-011 dataset contract only as a controlled experiment; the empirical CAP-011 contract remains NOT RUN until a real candidate system is executed with retained raw outputs and independent hallucination adjudication.
Any candidate system that is the same agent or model family that authored these tasks should disclose that overlap before its run is accepted.
